entries.title: Decline closes a card for a step only you can do
entries.body: Pressing Decline on a card for a step only you can do now closes the card and drops that step, and your first mate hears your no with anything you typed. Before, Decline posted your words as a reply and the same card came back. Words you type before pressing Not now on such a card now reach your first mate too.
entries.noPicture: The fix makes the card go away when you press Decline, which no still picture of a view shows.
